details_checked: The exact candidate clearly separates environment, placement/provider binding, process topology, operating profiles, and orthogonal policy axes.
Each recommended profile specifies persona, trigger/freshness, scope, outputs, authority, approval boundary, and degraded operation; concurrent operation and conflict rules are explicit.

The execution plan reuses current FastAPI APIs, worker/APScheduler, existing intelligence safeguards, adapter capabilities, webhooks, and WebSockets, while defining minimum new state and the durable-executor threshold.

Compatibility, migration, RBAC/isolation/privacy, observability/audit, cost/backpressure/idempotency, failures, rollback/kill switches, stop conditions, staged validation, exclusions, retained unknowns, and adversarial cases are complete.
implementation_options: Rejects flat exclusive modes as a conflation of trigger, persona, scope, and authority.
Retains policy axes internally and opinionated Operating Profiles for customer-facing UX.
Defers a full durable orchestration platform until measured APScheduler insufficiency conditions are met.
Defers a separate watchdog service, retaining Continuous Watch as a governed incremental worker policy.
Retains on-demand snapshots within Manager Briefing and Agent Assist but not as the sole solution.
Rejects general multi-agent roles as the primary abstraction.
Selects the required hybrid of policy axes, composable presets, and an incremental executor.
proposed_artifact: Approve the exact registered candidate v0: it recommends composable Operating Profiles—Manager Briefing and Agent Assist in the read-only MVP, then Continuous Watch—backed by independent policy axes and a staged, capability-gated path to durable guarded orchestration.
requirements_covered: Explicitly accepts the useful intent of watchdog/on-demand/analytical examples while correcting their classification and naming.
Avoids a combinatorial mutually exclusive mode model and defines safe composition/conflict resolution.
Delivers separate deliberate manager oversight and in-context agent analysis without conflating persona and cadence.
Uses continuous terminology at launch and conditions near-real-time claims on a supported event path and measured SLO.
Preserves human control and capability/RBAC/approval/audit/idempotency gates for any future external write.
Fits the observed architecture, preserves existing safeguards and routes, and defines when APScheduler is insufficient.
Provides a credible phased sequence that yields MVP value before generalized orchestration.
Includes concrete failure/degraded behavior, rollback, kill switches, and stop conditions.
States material unknowns and exclusions without asserting ServiceNow implementation or unsupported write parity.
Covers option rationale, migration, validation, risk controls, and adversarial webhook/isolation/cost/scheduler cases.
summary: The candidate fully satisfies the canonical brief and is safe, actionable, and appropriately incremental for Tickety's observed architecture.
